claim: None of the six official MCP reference servers speaks protocol revision 2026-07-28

baseline.source: sqlite-mcp on Python SDK 2.2.0, probed the same way
baseline.note: the control: a server on an SDK that implements the revision answers discover

scale: 6 official reference servers at their latest published versions: everything 2026.8.31, filesystem and memory on TypeScript SDK 1.30.0; fetch, time and git on Python SDK 1.30.0. Each probed down both negotiation paths on separate stdio connections.
code_path: model-free; stdio only; local subprocesses, no hosted endpoints
surprise: The two SDK families refuse server/discover with different codes. TypeScript 1.30.0 returns -32601 Method not found, the correct answer for an unknown method. Python 1.30.0 returns -32602 with the message 'Invalid request': the code means invalid params, the message names a different error again, and neither is right. A client that falls back to the handshake only on -32601 would fail against every Python v1 server.
expires: the moment either SDK family ships the July revision; re-run before quoting
